title: A duty with an enforcement record
footer: A documented technology-resilience case. Not AI-specific enforcement or evidence of customer compensation.
alt: BNM’s Bank Islam notice identifies the technology requirement, prolonged service disruptions between June 2023 and December 2024, and a RM1.745 million penalty. This is not an AI-specific case.

title: The plan proposes different institutional roles
footer: A faithful summary of the plan proposal. It does not establish that every proposed power is in force.
alt: E11 names the Digital Ministry as key lead, proposes central AI coordination and retains enforcement with sector regulators. These are proposed roles, not proof that new powers are in force.

title: Public-sector safeguards need their own legal basis
footer: This exclusion is not a finding that government has no other legal duties.
alt: Act 709 covers personal-data processing in commercial transactions within its stated scope, while section 3(1) excludes Federal and State Governments. Other legal obligations may still apply.
